artifacts.summary: 7-phase, 5-hour plan to add or amend validator-conforming inline report/summary skeletons in 8 lean- and formal-extension agent files, then redeploy and demonstrate zero-error, zero-auto-repair validation on a real lean dispatch.

memory_candidates.content: Agents are dispatched with only their own definition file loaded, so a terminus-writing agent (one that authors a report/summary/plan artifact) must carry a FULL inline skeleton in its own file -- linking the format doc in Context References is not sufficient, and neither is referring to a 'base' skeleton in a sibling agent file. This is why general-implementation-agent.md and general-research-agent.md each inline their own complete skeleton rather than cross-referencing one another, and why lean/formal agents that only linked the format doc produced non-conforming artifacts. Corollary for authoring: put the required-field/-section checks INSIDE the fenced skeleton block, since validate-artifact.sh's whole-file `grep -qF "**Field**:"` will happily match agent-authoring prose (e.g. a Context References bullet) that never reaches the produced artifact.
